audience: Control Plane operators and remote exec-server integrators
text: Codex exec-server now expects `process/start.cwd` as a `file:` URI, carries cwd as `PathUri`, and rejects non-native cwd before launch. Remote executor and MCP launcher clients should send target-native cwd URIs. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/28032
